About the Venue

A Place to Eat, Meet & Celebrate

Ncibane's Lifestyle Pub & Grill is a social hangout, shisanyama and event venue situated in Elalini / Bhongweni along Buffalo Pass Road in East London (KuGompo City), South Africa.

With spacious indoor and outdoor areas, food, table service, entertainment, free parking and wheelchair-accessible features, the venue welcomes people looking to enjoy time together.

Reported rating: 4.3/5 from more than 220 customer reviews (provided information; may change).
